info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Event subscriptions API

params.name: id
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given id

params.name: eventType
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given event type

params.name: eventName
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given event name

params.name: activityId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given activity id

params.name: executionId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given execution id

params.name: processInstanceId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions part of a process with the given id

params.name: withoutProcessInstanceId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions that have no process instance id

params.name: processDefinitionId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given process definition id

params.name: withoutProcessDefinitionId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions that have no process definition id

params.name: scopeId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions part of a scope with the given id

params.name: subScopeId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions part of a sub scope with the given id

params.name: withoutScopeId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions that have no scope id

params.name: scopeDefinitionId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given scope definition id

params.name: withoutScopeDefinitionId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions that have no scope definition id

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Only return event subscriptions which are created before the given date.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Only return event subscriptions which are created after the given date.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given tenant id.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: Only return event subscriptions that have no tenant id

params.name: configuration
params.description: Only return event subscriptions with the given configuration value.

params.name: withoutConfiguration
params.description: Only return event subscriptions that have no configuration value

params.name: sort
params.description: Property to sort on, to be used together with the order.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc'.

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first row to fetch. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rows to fetch, starting from start. Defaults to 10.
